1. The edit only matters through connectivity, and a pooled or skip parent behaves like a half-removed one. If false, partial weakening gives a distinct, non-monotone interaction (H3, H4, H5, H14, H18).
2. Conv upgrades add up across edges. If false, conv pairs are complementary or compounding in depth (H1, H6, H12, H13).

6. Middle edge 2 matters equally in all contexts. If false, it matters as a bridge only when its parents carry learned features (H6, H16).
7. Redundant capacity only gives diminishing returns. If false, it can actively hurt through overfitting (H10).
